next.support_replied: Read the reply and answer on the case page.

next.replacement_needed: Their helper canceled, so the time is set and the client is ready to book.
next.replacement_search_started: You were refunded in full. New offers will appear on your task. If you no longer need it, cancel the task.
next.badge_earned: See all your badges, and the next ones, on your account page.
next.city_open: Choose your neighborhood and add your home address. Then you can send offers on tasks near you.
next.city_live_client: Describe what you need in a few words. You choose who to book, and pay only when you book.

next.reward_ready: Pick the card you want on your Rewards page and redeem it within 90 days.
next.community_reply: Read the answer, and pin the one that helped.
next.community_helpful: See the conversation in the community.
next.question_received: Answer it on your task; every helper reads the answer.
next.question_answered: Read the answer, then make your offer.
next.saved_search_match: Open your search to see it with the others.
next.saved_search_digest: Open your search to see them.

next.review_reminder: After that, reviews for this booking close. They stay hidden until you've both written one.
next.saved_searches_digest: Your saved searches page has each one, with its own filters and alerts.
next.payment_refunded: It's back on the card you paid with in 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank.
next.address_recheck: There's nothing you need to do. We'll let you know when it's checked, usually within a day.

checked.question: How are helpers checked?
checked.answer: Before sending offers, every helper verifies a government ID with a live selfie and their home address. Clients see a badge with the date of each check.
checked.inHome: Before sending offers, every helper verifies a government ID with a live selfie and their home address. This service happens in your home, so helpers also need a cleared background check before they can take it.

remote.question: Can it be done remotely?
remote.answer: Yes. Post it as a remote task: your helper works with you by screen sharing, and you keep control of your device and your passwords.

Identity documents aren't included: we delete them within 30 days of our decision.
